have h_char_u : χ ↑u = 1 :=
  by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_eq_mod_d hd u
    have h_k : k ≡ 1 [MOD d] := hk
    have h_χ_u : χ ↑u = χ (↑1 : ZMod N) :=
      by
        rw [ZMod.coe_units]
        rw [ZMod.unitsMap_apply]
        rw [h_k]
        exact congrArg χ (congrArg (ZMod.mk _) h_k)
    rw [h_χ_u]
    rw [ZMod.one]

rw [h_char_u]
ring
